gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1

This PR makes the feed fetch retry once on failure, with tests covering the bounded retry. You are the author, and no spec governs it, so it was judged against its stated intent: the retry and its tests match the description, and nothing beyond that intent appears in the diff.

Merging waits on one thing: the required end-to-end check is still running on the latest commit. No problems need fixing, and no comments need a reply. Merge is not offered yet because that end-to-end check has not finished. Checks are watched only during delivery, so starting delivery is the way to reach merge.

I recommend deliver because the running end-to-end check is the only thing standing between this PR and merge.

Pick one:
1. deliver - watch the running end-to-end check, rebase on main if the branch falls behind, and continue until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. assess - post nothing, because no problems were found, and end the assessment without repairs.
3. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
